u5mr.label: Under-5 mortality rate
u5mr.caveat: Survival proxy for the adolescent cohort; not adolescent-specific.

adol_fert.label: Adolescent fertility rate
adol_fert.source: UN Population Division / World Bank SP.ADO.TFRT

stunting.label: Stunting prevalence, under-5
stunting.caveat: India value disputed against Poshan Tracker administrative data. See docs/CONTESTED.md.

suicide.label: Suicide mortality rate
suicide.source: WHO Global Health Estimates; NCRB for India
suicide.caveat: Registration completeness varies; under-reporting likely where suicide is stigmatised or criminalised.

ladder.label: Life evaluation (Cantril ladder)
ladder.source: Gallup World Poll via World Happiness Report
ladder.caveat: One perceptual question, ~1,000 respondents per country-year, 3-year mean, adults not adolescents. Construct validity contested. See docs/CONTESTED.md.

child_labour.label: Child labour
child_labour.caveat: Definitions differ across surveys; unpaid household work inconsistently captured.

electricity.label: Access to electricity
electricity.caveat: Population-level proxy. Connection is not reliable supply.

hlo.label: Harmonised learning outcome
hlo.source: Altinok, Angrist & Patrinos (2018) / World Bank HLO
hlo.caveat: Vintage 2005-2015. Imputed for 29 countries. China derives from PISA-participating provinces, not the national population.

youth_lit.label: Youth literacy rate 15-24
youth_lit.caveat: Self- or proxy-reported in several censuses.

neet.label: Youth NEET rate
neet.caveat: Subsistence and unpaid family work counted as employment in low-income settings depresses measured NEET.

y_unemp.label: Youth unemployment rate
y_unemp.caveat: Denominator is the labour force, so it rises where participation rises.

neet_gap.label: NEET gender gap
neet_gap.caveat: Inherits the comparability limits of the NEET series.

mobile_bb.label: Active mobile broadband subscriptions
mobile_bb.caveat: Subscriptions, not users; multi-SIM inflates this in some markets.
